children: Prime Line Distributors and Ferrarini USA are recalling about 1,513 pounds of guanciale items that were produced by Italy's Bome SRL due to the risk of listeria.

The Prime Line Distributors items were shipped to food-service and retail locations in Florida, the Agriculture Department's Food Safety and Inspection Service said. The Ferrarini USA products were shipped to distributors and food-service locations in California, Florida, Idaho, Illinois, Michigan, New Jersey, New York and Texas.
There have been no confirmed reports of illness, FSIS said. During import reinspection testing, a product sample confirmed positive for listeria.
